items.quote: With trial production expected by quarter 3 FY '28
items.statement: Ascent-K HDI PCB facility trial production by Q3FY28
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: set to commence its construction by June of '26
items.statement: Ascent-K HDI PCB facility construction to start by Jun-2026
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: this division is expected to grow by around 40% in FY '27
items.statement: Electronics division revenue growth of about 40% in FY27
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: remain optimistic of division's growth of 30% to 35% for both FY '27 and FY '28
items.statement: Railway division growth of 30-35% in both FY27 and FY28
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we expect a margin pressure of 50 to 100 bps at consolidated level
items.statement: Consolidated margin pressure of 50-100 bps, described as temporary
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we expect to receive INR78 crores under the PLI scheme
items.statement: PLI incentive receipt of INR 78 crore expected in FY27
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

items.quote: On the complete year side, we are estimating a growth of somewhere around 12% to 13% on the complete year.
items.statement: Industry growth of about 12-13% for FY27
items.speaker: Sachin Gupta

items.quote: Ascent will be around INR1200-odd crores
items.statement: Ascent capex of about INR 1,200 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

items.quote: there will be around INR700 crores to INR800 crores capex in all the other entities put together
items.statement: Capex in all other entities of INR 700-800 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

items.quote: from quarter 3, quarter 4 onwards of FY '28, we will start the mass production of HDI plant
items.statement: HDI PCB plant mass production from Q3-Q4 FY28
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: the margins, what we are expecting right now should be in the range of 9.5% to 10% range
items.statement: Electronics EBITDA margin of 9.5-10% after job work conversion
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: But the margins in the railway side, we expect in the range of 16% to 17%.
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: the markets are expecting to grow in about range of 13% to 14% range
items.statement: Consumer durables growth of 13-14%, in line with market expectation
items.speaker: Jasbir Singh

items.quote: we will be doing around INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores of overall capex
items.statement: Overall capex of INR 1,800-2,000 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

items.quote: it should be around INR1100 crores to INR1200 crores you can expect from the cash flow perspective
items.statement: Cash outflow for capex of INR 1,100-1,200 crore in FY27
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

items.quote: you can expect a similar or a little higher around INR1,400 crores, INR1,500 crores of cash outflow for the capex
items.statement: Cash outflow for capex of INR 1,400-1,500 crore in FY28
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

items.quote: So you can expect around INR700 crores to INR800 crores of net debt by year-end.
items.statement: Net debt of INR 700-800 crore by FY27 year-end
items.speaker: Sudhir Goyal

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management states it is very confident in about 40% electronics growth and a 30-35% railway growth outlook, while acknowledging a temporary margin pressure of 50-100 bps.
